Hayarigami 2 Portable - Keishichou Kaii.name: Hayarigami 2 Portable: Keishichou Kaii Jiken File
Hayarigami 2 Portable - Keishichou Kaii.summary: You are part of the elite police force team. Find the culprit and his identity before he finds you. Investigate urban legends associated with bloody murders via scientific or occult methods leading to different results. And only combination of these methods can reveal the truth behind the case.

Lanfeust of Troy.name: Lanfeust de Troy
Lanfeust of Troy.summary: Lanfeust de Troy (Lanfeust of Troy) is a DS/PSP game based on the popular French comic series.

Nippon no Asoko de.name: Nippon no Asoko de
Nippon no Asoko de.summary: Play as an alien sent to research Japan and see if it’s a suitable spot for outer space tourists. What makes the title extremely unique is it has an actual map of Japan as the setting. You can visit real landmarks like Tokyo Tower in a tiny yellow UFO at day or night.

Seigneur des Anneaux, Le - Tactics.name: The Lord of the Rings: Tactics
Seigneur des Anneaux, Le - Tactics.summary: Return to Middle-earth in this tactical RPG and decide the fate of The Third Age. Build a Fellowship of heroes or create a force of evil with hundreds of skill, weapon, and ability upgrades. Send your armies into battle across legendary locations from the film trilogy and J.R.R. Tolkien's fiction. A simultaneous turn-based multiplayer system delivers a combat unrivaled by any Tactics game. The board is set, the pieces are in motion. Middle-earth awaits you.

Uta no Prince-sama - Music 2.name: Uta no Prince-sama: Music 2
Uta no Prince-sama - Music 2.summary: Second music game of the Uta no Prince-sama series, which contains 33 songs from Uta no Prince-sama Debut, Uta no Prince-sama All Star, and related released CDs.

Virtua Tennis 3.name: Virtua Tennis 3
Virtua Tennis 3.summary: Virtua Tennis 3 (Sega Professional Tennis: Power Smash 3 in Japan) is the second arcade game sequel to Sega's tennis game franchise, Virtua Tennis. The arcade version of Virtua Tennis 3 is powered by the PC-based Sega Lindbergh arcade system board. Ports for the PC, Xbox 360, PlayStation Portable and PlayStation 3 consoles are also available with a traditional collection of tennis minigames that the home versions of Virtua Tennis are known for. In 2009, Sega updated and re-created Virtua Tennis 3 in Virtua Tennis 2009.

Zill O'll Infinite Plus.name: Zill O'll Infinite Plus
Zill O'll Infinite Plus.summary: Zill O'll Infinite Plus is an enhanced portable edition of Zill O'll Infinite released for the PSP. In addition to carrying over the content of the PlayStation 2 version, it introduces a new starting scenario, more recruitable characters, additional story events and further character-specific routes. More than 120 new events were added, along with new scenarios and endings, bringing the total number of possible endings to 53. Several gameplay systems were also adjusted to make progression and repeated playthroughs more convenient.
